Legal.placeholderNotice: This is a short placeholder. The full version will be published before Vano's official launch.
Legal.termsS1Body: Vano lets you open an online shop for your fashion business and share it with a link. You must give accurate information and keep your password safe.
Legal.termsS2Body: You are responsible for the products, photos, prices and descriptions you publish. Don't publish anything illegal, misleading or that you don't have the right to use. We may suspend a shop that breaks these rules.
Legal.termsS3Body: Orders are agreed directly between you and your customers on WhatsApp. Vano doesn't take part in the sale, doesn't handle payments and isn't responsible for deliveries.
Legal.termsS4Body: Questions about these terms? Use the contact link at the bottom of the page.
Legal.privacyS1Body: Your account email, your shop details (name, link, WhatsApp number, currency, language) and the products and photos you add.
Legal.privacyS2Body: We count shop and product views and WhatsApp clicks per day. We don't store visitors' IP addresses, browser details or any personal data for these counts.
Legal.privacyS3Body: Vano doesn't handle payments, so we never see your or your customers' card or mobile money details.
Legal.privacyS4Body: To ask about your data or delete your account, use the contact link at the bottom of the page.

start.title: Getting started
start.q1: How do I open my shop?
start.a1: Tap “Open my shop for free”, create your account with your email and a password, then fill in your shop name, link and WhatsApp number. It takes about 2 minutes.
start.q2: Do I need a website or technical skills?
start.a2: No. Vano is your shop: no designer, no hosting, no code. If you can use WhatsApp, you can use Vano.
start.q3: Does it work on my phone?
start.a3: Yes. Vano is made for phones first, for you and for your customers, even on a slow connection.

products.title: Products
products.q1: How do I add a product?
products.a1: From your dashboard, tap “Add product”, take or choose a photo, then add a name, price, category, sizes and colors.
products.q2: How many photos can I add?
products.a2: Up to 6 photos per product. They are compressed automatically so your shop stays fast.
products.q3: Can I mark a product as sold out?
products.a3: Yes. A sold-out product stays visible with a “Sold out” label, and the order button is turned off.

orders.title: Orders on WhatsApp
orders.a1: They tap “Order on WhatsApp” on a product. WhatsApp opens with a message to you that already includes the product, size, color and price.
orders.q2: Do my customers need an account?
orders.a2: No. They open your link, browse and order. Nothing to install, nothing to sign up for.
orders.a3: Directly to you. You agree on payment in the chat: cash on delivery, mobile money or whatever you already use. Vano doesn't handle payments.

link.title: Your shop link
link.q1: What does my link look like?
link.a1: vano.app/your-shop-name. You choose it when you create your shop.
link.a2: In your WhatsApp status and chats, your Instagram bio and your Facebook page. Anywhere your customers already are.
link.q3: Can I change my link later?
link.a3: Yes, in your shop settings, as long as the new link is free. Your old link stops working, so share the new one.

pricing.title: Pricing and trial
pricing.a1: Your first 2 months are free with all Pro features, and no payment method is needed. After that you can pick a plan or stay on Free.
pricing.a2: Free: up to 10 products. Pro: up to 50 products, full design options and shop stats. Business: unlimited products and team accounts. See the Pricing page for details.
pricing.q3: How will I pay for a plan?
pricing.a3: Payment methods will be announced before your trial ends. M-Pesa is planned.

account.title: Account
account.q1: I forgot my password. What do I do?
account.a1: Contact us using the WhatsApp or email details below and we'll help you get back into your shop.
account.q2: Can I change my shop's language?
account.a2: Yes. Your shop can be in English or French, from your shop settings. Customers always see your shop in the language you chose.
account.q3: How do I delete my account?
account.a3: Contact us using the details below and we'll delete your account and your shop.
